Something that we’ll be seeing more of in the future are range-extended electric vehicles. Many technologies have something called an adoption S-curve. Basically, we invent something, we get really excited about it and the media reinforce a public opinion how that something will change the world in a matter of a few years. In reality the process takes much longer. 

Right now, when it comes to EVs we are somewhere between the Early Adopters and The Early Majority. This is something that organizational theorist Geoffrey Moore calls the chasm. This sub-transition can be particularly difficult to achieve. We started with regular hybrids, evolved to plug in hybrids and the next stage will be range-extended electric vehicles.
